ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Anmol India Limited has submitted its routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the NSE and BSE. The certificate confirms that this regulation is not applicable to the company for the period, as all of its shares are entirely in dematerialized form and no requests for rematerialization or dematerialization were received. This filing indicates standard operational compliance with no material impacts or red flags, highlighting a fully electronic shareholder base for the quarter.
